questions.prompt: Someone says, "I can't change this note." Choose the matching negative agreement.

wrongReasons: 表示“我也不能”用 Neither + can + I 的倒装结构；So can I 表示肯定附和。
表示“我也不能”用 Neither + can + I 的倒装结构；So can I 表示肯定附和。

questions.prompt: Complete the present simple: "Everybody ___ to have lunch in the garden." Use want.

questions.prompt: Choose the past continuous form: "When my husband ___ into the dining room, he dropped some coins."

my husband 为单数，过去进行时用 was going；背景动作进行时，另一个动作 dropped 发生。

questions.prompt: Complete the past perfect: "Tommy had already ___ the coins." Use swallow. Write ONE word.

questions.grammarPoint: Past perfect before a past event
questions.prompt: Complete the earlier action: "When George came downstairs, the thieves ___ already gone."

窃贼离开早于 George 下楼这一过去动作，用过去完成时 had gone。

questions.prompt: Make the clause negative: "They had entered the house."

answers: They didn't had entered the house.

commonMistakes.feedback: 过去完成时否定句在 had 后面加 not，entered 保持过去分词形式。

questions.grammarPoint: Relative clauses: who as a subject
questions.prompt: Choose the relative word for a person as subject: "The lady ___ is standing behind the counter."
questions.explanation: 先行词 lady 指人，从句缺主语，用 who；whom 不能在这里作主语。

commonMistakes.feedback: need 用作情态动词时，否定形式 need not / needn’t 后直接加 water，不保留 to；它表示不必，不是禁止。
